object: Resumable local-first FIELD MEDIA REFINERY automation spine

behavior.resumable: Reuse unchanged records by relative_path + bytes + mtime_ns; hashes and quantitative fingerprints are not recomputed.
behavior.appearance_clusters: Triage/donor discovery only; never composition or meaning.
behavior.semantic_loop: Worker emits one batch overlay into memory/semantic-overlays/<batch>.json; rerun binds reviewed semantics to exact item hashes.
behavior.recipe_loop: Without semantic review only bounded AESTHETIC/surface transfer is proposed. With reviewed semantics the same batch may emit C/A/P/M one-axis candidates.
behavior.render_boundary: No renderer is called. Recipe queue remains backend UNBOUND for later TRANSLATE.
behavior.heavy_outputs: Contact sheets and control maps stay local under derived/ by default.
behavior.video: Census + ffprobe metadata only by default; no frame flood.

defect_caught.issue: Initial batch IDs depended only on parent+chunk and collided across unrelated ROOT batches.
defect_caught.correction: Batch identity now includes source snapshot + parent + offset + exact item identities.
defect_caught.verified: B260728B and House OS samples now produce distinct batch IDs.

worker_contract.stop: No source mutation, publication, generation, or new project creation.

next_single_action: Run archive-recovery over the next large local image root. Use worker-packets.jsonl for parallel semantic passes; rerun; select only reviewed C/A/P/M recipes for TRANSLATE.
